payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance metrics comparing NUS and ABUS, indicating how much NUS outperformed ABUS in terms of success rates and average rewards.

claims.text: The best performing policy trained on the NUS achieved a 93.4% success rate and 13.8 average rewards, while the best performing policy trained on the ABUS achieved a 90.0% success rate and 13.3 average rewards.
Policies trained with the NUS achieved an average success rate of 94.0% when tested on the ABUS, compared to 99.5% for ABUS policies tested on ABUS.
After 4000 dialogues, the average success rate of NUS policies tested on ABUS was 97.3%, indicating a significant performance difference.
